submitted.rationale: Five EQE measurements covered the Sb fraction range 0.24–0.68. The response peaks broadly across 0.41–0.52: idx12 (Sb 0.411) gave 0.840%, idx13 (0.448) 0.824% and idx15 (0.519) 0.771%. It falls off at both ends: idx6 (0.242) gave 0.240% and idx20 (0.675) 0.013%. idx12 is the highest value measured.
